definitions.gloss: battle formation; military formation; tactical arrangement
definitions.explanation: The arrangement or positioning of troops or forces for battle. Used in historical and military contexts.

definitions.gloss: formation; lineup; arrangement of players or team members
definitions.explanation: By extension, the tactical arrangement of players in sports or the positioning of participants in games. Common in gaming and sports contexts.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{陣|じん}→陣：30535_jin⟧ (camp, position, battle line) and {形|けい} (shape, form). Originally a military term referring to the tactical arrangement of forces, now also widely used in sports and gaming.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {陣形|じんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧: to form a formation
- {陣形|じんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧: to arrange the formation
- {陣形|じんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧: to change the formation
- {陣形|じんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}す→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧: to break the formation
- ⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧{陣形|じんけい}: offensive formation
- ⟦{守備|しゅび}→守備：15509_shubi⟧{陣形|じんけい}: defensive formation

HISTORICAL FORMATIONS:
Famous Japanese battle formations include:
- {鶴翼|かくよく}: crane-wing — troops spread wide to envelop the enemy
- {魚鱗|ぎょりん}: fish-scale — a wedge formation for concentrated attack
- {方円|ほうえん}: circle — a defensive formation against attack from all sides

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {隊形|たいけい}: formation, lineup — more commonly used for marching or parade formations; {陣形|じんけい} emphasizes tactical or combat positioning
- フォーメーション: formation — the English loanword, used especially in sports like soccer and basketball
